top_signal.title: Furniture business owners
top_signal.summary: Looking for some small furniture store business owners, I just started mine a few months ago and I need help with growing. I sell furniture local, 90% through Facebook marketplace and 10% Craigslist and OfferUp. I am getting close to 6 figures but think I can do better, I have a site that’s easy, pick product, pickup or delivery, day and time slot. Got no sales for 1 month of advertising only meta ads. Was spending 15 dollars a day. I would like to hear your stories on how you grow or any ideas from anyone. Thank you. I have business cards. I have 8 Google reviews I started doing that now with pictures on my Google profile and posts every few days. Based in the US.       submitted by     /u/Sufficient_Key9080       [link]       [comments]
